title: Chapter 142 The Time Is Ripe
content:
Chapter 142 The Time Is Ripe

Everyone was obviously a little surprised when they saw Lu Xue.

"Oh, I've been away for a long time, so I'll come back and take a look."

Lu Xue looked at the familiar people and smiled.

When everyone heard this, they nodded immediately.

They thought Lu Xue suddenly came back and something happened.

I think so, this is the city lord's most precious daughter, how could something happen?

"By the way, Miss, your mother?"

At this time, someone asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned and then said, "My mother,"

Lu Xue said that when she first learned about her mother's power, she was also shocked. Although she didn't understand her mother's battles everywhere, she didn't ask much.

But she believed that Yan Lingyun must have some reason for doing this.

Seeing that Lu Xue really didn't know anything, everyone didn't ask much.

"Xiaoxue, when are you going back?"

Gu Chen asked.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was silent for a moment, "Emm, I'm just coming back to see you, I should go back in two days."

"Since that's the case, then that's fine. I'll go back with Xiaoxue in two days. Let me negotiate with my wife about the next thing."

Gu Chen said slowly.

The Divine Dynasty is so dynamic and quiet, it is definitely impossible to say that it has no purpose.

Since the city lord has already explained, all they have to do is to help his wife with all their strength.

So before this, we should greet the lady first so that they can prepare in advance.

Hearing Gu Chen's words, everyone pondered for a moment and nodded in agreement.

"Brother Gu, thank you for your hard work."

"Okay, no problem, leave it to me."

Then everyone dispersed.

It is worth mentioning that Yun Qi has also broken through to the super god realm and has been fighting for many years. Yun Qi's fighting spirit seems to have a qualitative change.

"General Yunqi."

When Yunqi was about to leave, Lu Xue stepped forward and called Yunqi.

"Oh? Is there anything wrong with the lady looking for me?"

Seeing that it was Lu Xue, Yunqi immediately showed a kind smile.

But even so, he still couldn't hide his murderous aura. He looked like a ruthless man who had been through the battlefield for a long time.

Even Lu Xue was slightly shocked.

"General Yunqi, it's Xiaoqing who is looking for you. He has something to tell you."

Immediately, Ao Qing came out of Lu Xue's sleeve.

"Ao Qing?"

When Yun Qi saw Ao Qing, he was a little confused.

I still don’t seem to have any intersection with Ao Qing.

At this time, Ao Qing said, "Brother, I can see that you seem to be in a bottleneck recently."

Upon hearing this, Yun Qi was shocked.

After a moment of silence, Yun Qi nodded slightly.

"Yes, although I have broken through to the realm of breaking the gods, my future path is a bit blurry."

Seeing Yun Qi admitting generously, Ao Qing smiled and said, "Brother, do you know the God of War Star Domain?"

The God of War Star Domain is now known to have few star domains with no fluctuations in the star domain.

At the beginning, the Divine Dynasty originally planned to directly capture the God of War Star Domain.

After all, the God of War Star Domain is average, and Tang Sheng, the only one who can make a move, was stolen in the battle with the Divine Dynasty.

But in the end, the Divine Dynasty did not take action, perhaps because the God of War Star Domain did not have much value, or because it was respecting the powerful God of War back then.

So the God of War Star Realm is still safe and sound until now.

And Yun Qi naturally knew about the God of War Star Domain.

Similarly, he also respected the God of War back then. Although he had never seen it, the God of War back then seemed to have chosen to face countless powerful enemies alone because of his protection subordinates, and eventually died in vain.

"I naturally know about the God of War Star Domain."

Yunqi nodded.

"Brother, I want to tell you that if you want to go further, you can try your luck in the God of War Star Realm. I believe you will definitely gain something."

He smiled arrogantly.

At this time, Yun Qi was also in deep thought.

After all, that was a star field where a god of war had appeared. Maybe it would be really rewarding as Ao Qing said.

Thinking of this, Yun Qi nodded.

"Okay, since that's the case, I'll go there."

After saying that, Yun Qi did not stop too much, returned to the army and gave instructions, and then headed towards the God of War Star Domain.

When he was in place, Lu Xue asked in confusion: "Xiaoqing, how did you know?"

Didn’t Ao Qing go to Tianlin Star Domain to participate in the war? Why did he even know about the God of War Star Domain?

Hearing Lu Xue’s doubts.

Ao Qing smiled and said, "My little master, do you think I am you, nothing is wrong,"

Before he finished speaking, Ao Qing choked.

It was over, and accidentally said what I thought.

At this time, Lu Xue had already exposed her fierce teeth.

The next moment, Lu Xue directly grabbed Ao Qing's fate's neck.

"You dare to say that to me, you're done!"

"My master, listen to my argument!"

"Don't listen, don't listen!"

Then, Ao Qing's scream sounded from the deserted city.

Ao Qing, who usually seemed to be afraid of nothing, soon showed a look of fear.

If others can't break his defense, that's someone else, not including Lu Xue.

To be precise, it does not include Lu Xue's family.

Lu Xue's breath was soon revealed.

Feeling Lu Xue's breath, the strong men in Huangcheng were shocked.

He is worthy of being the only descendant of the city lord.

Now, Lu Xue's aura has actually reached the super-divine realm and has already shown a trend of breakthrough.

This is too fast.

After being shocked, everyone withdrew their gaze and then started practicing hard.

They had a premonition that a great war would inevitably come next.

.........

At the same time, in a certain star field.

It is extremely strange here, without a trace of life, and everything around it seems dull.

And in this place, a phantom appeared.

I saw it slowly heading towards the boundary.

"So many years have passed, and the time has finally come."

Buzz —

The boundary is broken.

A gorgeous scene suddenly appeared in front of you.

It is the appearance of the known star field.

Looking at the star field in front of him, the phantom suddenly burst into a shrill laugh.

"Hmph, hahahaha, humble ants, get ready to welcome destruction!"

And at this time, a figure appeared in the void.

Looking at the phantom at the border in front of him, he immediately showed a solemn look.

"You are a creature in the unknown star field."

His clothes were obviously from the Divine Dynasty.

However, Phantom ignored his words and took action directly.

Boom!

A roar sounded.

The scene was suddenly nothingness.

"Shen Chen."

At this moment, a sound suddenly came from the void behind him.

The phantom looked back and frowned slightly.

"Come back first."

The voice sounded behind itself again.

The phantom was silent for a moment and said slowly, "I think the time is ripe now, and no one can stop our clan."

"This is the order of the patriarch."
